title: 第23章 反思与收获二合一第24章 奖励与盘问二合一大章
slug: 幕后黑手我的词条邪到发癫
content_zh:
一门之隔，屋内是残忍的凶杀进行时，癫狂而压抑的苦笑声回荡。
楼道里却静到可怕，邻居仿若全都聋了一样，睡的香甜，没有一个人被吵醒，更没人开门探头张望。
很奇怪吧~
不，一点都不奇怪。
这就是下城人的生存智慧，棚户区里的居民更深谙此道，何况，霸占二楼那户的是青狼帮的恶棍，穷凶极恶的，多瞥一眼都可能惹上事儿。
3.25，05:11。
这是录完视频手机上显示的时间。
“你的手机号是多少，我把视频传给你留个纪念。”冯睦见尸体整个脖子都被攮碎，就剩层皮了，才乐呵呵的说道。
马威杀了张桐，整个人的心灵也好似完成了一场蜕变。
“大佬，别搞我了啦，你留着就好，发给我，我晚上会做噩梦的。”马威抹了把脸，带点神经质的表情。
他虽然依旧非常畏惧眼前戴着黑口罩的男人，但，突然就不那么颤颤巍巍，心底多了些病态的表达欲。
马威不擅长剖析自己的心理变化，但，冯睦稍稍思索一下，便大致明白咋回事儿了。
“因为从敌对关系，转变为胁从和帮凶，心态得到放松，又因为杀了亲密的大哥，开始有点病态黑化了嘛。”
“如此一来，这颗插入青狼帮内的眼位算是成了，而且说不得，会比我想象的更有用些。”
“当然，提防也得多一点，毕竟，黑化的棋子容易反噬。”
冯睦把手机揣入口袋，决定回家后把视频做个备份，这是对方的命门，他可得妥善保管。
10分钟后。
冯睦坐在沙发上，马威跪在旁边，手法熟练的为他做了伤口止血处理，胸前和手腕都上了药缠了纱布。
以往，马威就是这么给桐哥处理的。
冯睦面无表情，余光扫瞥地上尚有余温的尸体，后者森白的眼珠子怒瞪着。

就有种夫前目犯，哎，不对，是未亡人妻…..的诡异既视感。
药粉是青狼帮秘制的，止血效果优秀，缠上纱布遮上衣服，从外面看不出来异样。
冯睦也便熄了吸点马威的血疗伤的邪念。
他在马威这里，已经暴露了[食铁者]和[狂血]的一点威能，虽然，对方未必看的懂门道。但，以防万一，[盛宴]是他的底牌，他得藏一手。
马威下意识的摸了摸脖子，不知道是不是错觉，他总觉得后者的目光时不时会瞄自己的脖子，令人后脖颈直冒凉气。
马威收起医疗箱，试探性问道：“大佬有什么事需要我做吗？”
“上道，我喜欢聪明人。”冯睦拉了拉口罩，把脸遮的更严实，笑道，“我听说青狼帮最近疯了似的拿个名单在找人？”
马威猜不出冯睦是随口一问，还是根本就是冲这事来的。
他偷偷扬头，视线与之交汇一瞬，后者眼瞳里还残留着血色，看不出情绪波澜。
马威内心一凛，将自己知道的和盘托出：“帮里怀疑郑航死了，凶手是47中的学生，所以在查。”
马威没多嘴解释郑航是谁，那会显得自己很蠢。
因为，无论对方是何身份目的，但既然问到此事，就必然不可能真的啥都不清楚。
冯睦扫了眼地上还未干透的尸体，又瞥了眼鱼缸里的蜥蜴，最后才看向餐桌上用来垫盘子的一沓a4纸。
马威连忙端开盘子，把名单抽出来，又用纸巾擦了擦上面沾的油污，才递给冯睦。
他说：“我听桐哥说过，名单是二头目马斌，也就是斌哥圈出来的，帮里复印了许多份，下面小弟大都散出去挨着名单查。”
他又道：“桐哥因为斌哥交代了更重要的事情，所以才没紧着此事。”
content_en:
Across the door, inside the house, a brutal murder was being carried out, with maniacal and suppressed bitter laughter echoing.
It was eerily quiet in the corridor. The neighbors seemed to be deaf. They were sleeping soundly. No one was woken up, and no one opened the door to look around.
Very strange~
No, not surprising at all.
This is the survival wisdom of the people in the lower city, and the residents in the shanty towns know this better. What's more, the people occupying the second floor are the villains of the Green Wolf Gang. They are so vicious that even one more glance may cause trouble.
3.25, 05:11.
This is the time displayed on the phone after recording the video.
"What's your mobile phone number? I'll send you the video as a souvenir." Feng Mu said cheerfully when he saw that the entire neck of the corpse had been smashed to pieces, leaving only a layer of skin.
Ma Wei killed Zhang Tong, and his whole soul seemed to have completed a transformation.
"Boss, stop messing with me. Just keep it and send it to me. I'll have nightmares at night." Ma Wei wiped his face with a nervous expression.
Although he was still very afraid of the man wearing a black mask in front of him, he suddenly became less trembling and had a more pathological desire for expression in his heart.
Ma Wei was not good at analyzing his own psychological changes, but after Feng Mu thought about it for a moment, he roughly understood what was going on.
"Because the relationship changed from hostility to coercion and accomplice, my mentality was relaxed, and because I killed my close eldest brother, I started to become a little sick and dark."
"In this way, the eye inserted into the Green Wolf Gang is finally completed, and I don't know, it will be more useful than I imagined."
"Of course, you have to be more careful. After all, blackened chess pieces are easy to bite back."
Feng Mu put his cell phone in his pocket and decided to make a backup copy of the video after returning home. This was the other person's destiny and he had to keep it properly.
10 minutes later.
Feng Mu sat on the sofa, and Ma Wei knelt next to him. He skillfully treated his wounds to stop the bleeding. His chest and wrists were covered with medicine and gauze.
In the past, this was how Ma Wei dealt with Brother Tong.
Feng Mu's face was expressionless, and he glanced at the still warm body on the ground with his peripheral vision. The latter's pale eyes were staring angrily.
There is a strange sense of déjà vu, as if the husband is seeing her in front of her, oh, no, it is the widowed wife...
The medicinal powder is secretly made by the Qinglang Gang and has excellent hemostasis effect. Wrap it in gauze and cover it with clothes, so nothing will look strange from the outside.
Feng Mu also gave up his evil thoughts of sucking some of Ma Wei's blood to heal his wounds.
Here in Ma Wei, he has already exposed some of the power of [Iron Eater] and [Crazy Blood], although the other party may not understand the rules. But, just in case, [Feast] is his trump card, and he has to hide it.
Ma Wei subconsciously touched his neck. He didn't know if it was an illusion. He always felt that the latter's eyes would glance at his neck from time to time, which made people feel cold on the back of their necks.
Ma Wei put away the medical kit and asked tentatively: "Boss, is there anything you need me to do?"
"Shangdao, I like smart people." Feng Mu pulled up his mask, covering his face more tightly, and said with a smile, "I heard that the Green Wolf Gang has been going crazy recently with a list of people looking for people?"
Ma Wei couldn't guess whether Feng Mu asked casually, or whether it was because of this matter.
He secretly raised his head, and his eyes met with his for a moment. There was still blood in the latter's eyes, and no emotion could be seen.
Ma Wei was shocked and told everything he knew: "The gang suspects that Zheng Hang is dead. The murderer is a student from No. 47 Middle School, so we are investigating."
Ma Wei didn't say much to explain who Zheng Hang was, as that would make him look stupid.
Because, no matter what the other party's identity and purpose is, since you ask about this matter, it is impossible to really know everything.
Feng Mu glanced at the still-dry corpse on the ground, then at the lizard in the fish tank, and finally looked at the stack of A4 paper on the dining table used to place the plates.
Ma Wei quickly opened the plate, took out the list, wiped the grease on it with a paper towel, and then handed it to Feng Mu.
He said: "I heard Brother Tong say that the list is twoThe leader, Ma Bin, who was circled by Brother Bin, made many copies for the gang, and most of the subordinates dispersed to check the list. "
He added: "Brother Tong didn't bother with this matter because Brother Bin explained something more important. "
